Use with: 5JB for material specifically created for or aimed at young men or boys, 5JA for material specifically created for or aimed at young women or girls, 5PS*, 5PT for works aimed at LGBTQIA+ youth, or other 5P* qualifiers for works relating to specific groups, or 5L* for works about specific age groups, for example, 5LFE for works about older teenagers, 5PHA* codes when discussing family members, etc

YXH.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Relationships (non-family / groups)
YXH.notes: Use for: relationships within peer or social groups, interpersonal relationships, frenemies, cliques, gangs, learning about relationships, skills for interaction with others outside families and other relationship topics, relationships with adults from a young persons perspective, dealing with the adult world, etc

YXHB.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Friends and friendships
YXHB.notes: Also class here: making new friends, friendship groups, found family, issues around relationships with friends, such as conformity, popularity or isolation within a group of friends, end of friendships, advice about making friends, etc

YXHL.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Dating, relationships, romance and love
YXHL.notes: Also class here: topics like first attraction, being in a couple, advice about romantic relationships, dating for the first time, first love, unrequited love, also advice about boundaries, consent and intimacy in a romantic relationship, kissing, advice for breaking up, ending a relationship, problems in relationships

YXHP.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Life skills and choices
YXHP.notes: Also class here: manners, behaviour, dilemmas, consequences, responsibilities, skills for interacting with modern life, other people, following or not following rules, getting into trouble, taking responsibility for actions, assuming the consequences, not using violence, not hitting, kicking or biting, etc

YXHY.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Teenage pregnancy
YXHY.notes: Also class here: teenage parenthood, teenage mums and dads. Use for: works aimed at young people explaining pregnancy, birth, parenthood or topics around being a young mother or father

YXJ.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Drugs and addiction
YXJ.notes: Also class here: topics around substance addiction, alcohol abuse, etc

YXK.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Disability, impairments and special needs
YXK.notes: Also class here: physical disabilities and impairments, visible or invisible disabilities or conditions, wheelchair users, etc. Use with: 5PM* Qualifiers as appropriate

YXL.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Physical and mental health conditions
YXL.notes: Use all YXL* codes for: titles aimed either at young people who have a particular condition or to help understand others who have a particular condition. Use all YXL* codes with: 5PM* Qualifiers as appropriate. NB: YXL* codes may be used with V* codes when there is no specific Y* code or qualifier but if mixing YXL* codes with V* codes, the YXL* code or another Y* code must be designated as the Main Subject and sent with a 5A* qualifier

YXLB.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Illness and specific physical health conditions
YXLB.notes: Also class here: living with disease and long-term physical conditions, injuries, first aid, medicine, titles that explain specific illnesses, diseases, etc to young people. Use with: YNH for history of medicine, plagues and disease in the past, histories of pandemics and epidemics, etc

YXLB1.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Cancer

YXLD.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Mental health and mental wellbeing
YXLD.notes: Also class here: mental disorders, trauma and traumatic experiences. Use for: works that help children or teenagers deal with mental health, personal trauma or traumatic events around them, how to process or talk about trauma, with adverse childhood experiences, advice about good mental health and wellbeing

YXLD1.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Eating disorders and body image
YXLD1.notes: Also class here: ARFID, anorexia, bulimia, binge eating, body dysmorphia, purging disorder, disordered eating, advice about body acceptance, body positivity, body neutrality

YXLD2.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Anxiety, depression and self-harm
YXLD2.notes: Also class here: panic attacks, severe stress

YXLD6.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Positive / good mental health
YXLD6.notes: Also class here: positive self-image, well-being. Use for: works that explain, help or give advice about good mental health and wellness, about judging life positively and feeling good, positive wellbeing, positive images

YXM.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Multicultural
YXM.notes: Use for: works on social and cultural topics linked to multiculturalism, pluriculturalism, biculturalism and multicultural, pluricultural or bicultural societies

YXN.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Racism and anti-racism
YXN.notes: Also class here: xenophobia, race relations. Use for: works about discrimination and prejudice based on skin colour, race or ethnic origin, or prejudices based on the perception that someone is foreign or from outside the community, and issues of inequality and discrimination, as well as measures to address racism. Use with: YNH for historical topics

YXP.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Diversity, equality, equity and inclusion
YXP.notes: Use for: books that deal with these topics and stories with a particularly diverse cast of characters, or which illustrate accessibility, social justice, equity, diversity, or inclusivity (DEI) within the context of the story without necessarily being the subject of the story. Use with: YF* codes for stories and values from 5P* INTEREST Qualifiers as appropriate

YXPB.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Prejudice and intolerance
YXPB.notes: Also class here: discrimination, injustice, the judgements of others. Use with: YNH for historical topics

YXQ.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Bullying, violence, abuse and peer pressure
YXQ.notes: Also class here: use of violent or abusive language. Use for: works that explore these topics, often titles aimed at explaining or helping young people understand or deal with these topics. Use with: YF* when it is the major element of the story

YXQD.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Abuse / exploitation
YXQD.notes: Also class here: physical, mental, emotional or sexual abuse, coercive control, domestic abuse, or works aimed at young people about criminal exploitation, debt bondage, exploitation of vulnerable children by criminal gangs

YXQF.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Bullying and harassment
YXQF.notes: Also class here: online trolling and bullying, coercion, cyberbullying, cyberstalking, physical or verbal bullying or harassment, relational bullying, collective bullying or mobbing, bullies and accomplices, victims of bullying, effects of bullying and harassment, bystander effect, school bullying, victimisation

YXQP.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Violence
YXQP.notes: Also class here: Knife violence, gun violence, bombs, violent acts, acts of terrorism, kidnapping, violent threats, violent rampages. Use for: works aimed at young people dealing with physical violence or conflict involving weapons, helping young people deal with knife crime, with gun violence, stabbings, shootings, violent gang crimes, school shootings, violence of war, for works helping young people avoid violence, or deal with the trauma of weapons related violence

YXR.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Personal safety
YXR.notes: Also class here: dealing with strangers, road safety, safety in the home etc. Use with: YXZE for titles about personal safety in the event of an emergency

YXS.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Runaways
YXS.notes: Also class here: fugitives, escapees. Use for: works that look at young people that run away and reasons around this, running away from home, or family or school or escaping things like repression, slavery, conflict, etc. Use with: YF* codes for stories about runaways, with YNB for biographies of runaways, or YNH for historical approaches

YXT.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: School, education and teachers
YXT.notes: Use for: works that explore topics like starting school, attending school, going to a new school, school life, education topics, titles about teachers and educators, school librarians

YXTB.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Truancy and school problems
YXTB.notes: Use for: works about issues at school, around repeated absence, non-attendance, avoiding school, etc

YXV.label: Teenage personal and social topics: Advice on careers and further education, leaving school
YXV.notes: Use for: titles about work, jobs, careers, professions aimed at a young audience but not educational

YXW.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: First / new experiences and life changes
YXW.notes: Also class here: Dealing with and understanding change, talking about change, changes or new experiences like moving home, living in a new town, starting a new school, making new friends, a new family, new siblings, etc. Use for: titles that explore or deal with major or significant new experiences or change in the life or world of a young person, how to deal or cope with this experience or change, or explains about these experiences or changes, from the perspective of the child or teenager etc. Use with: other Y* codes or qualifiers to give more details of the main theme or experience

YXWP.label: Children’s / Teenage personal and social topics: Growing up / coming of age
YXWP.notes: Use for: titles that deal with the changes from childhood or youth to adulthood, such as taking on adult responsibilities, career choices, character growth, gaining independence, self-reliance, moving away from home, going to university, first experience of love, etc. Use with: YF* for coming of age fiction, YXA* codes for works about changes to the body, or sex, YXHL for first love, etc

YXZ.label: Children’s / Teenage: Social issues / topics
YXZ.notes: Also class here: social activism, general works on social justice. Use for: titles that deal directly with the topics or explain debates around social issues for young people. Use with: other YX* codes to give greater detail; YF* fiction codes for stories that are about these topics. NB: YXZ may be used with JBF* codes if there are no more precise Y* codes but if mixing YXZ with JBF* codes, a Y* code MUST be designated as the Main Subject and sent with a 5A* qualifier

YXZB.label: Children’s / Teenage social topics: Activism / activists
YXZB.notes: Use for: titles about social activism, environmental activism, human rights, social or civil rights movements, causes and other forms of engagement as activists by young people, volunteering or volunteer engagement. Use with: other YN* or YX* codes to give greater detail and with YNB for biographies of activists

YXZC.label: Children’s / Teenage social topics: Identity / belonging
YXZC.notes: Use for: titles that explore topics or themes around notions of identity and belonging, as individuals or as part of a particular group or communities, identity or belonging based on relationship to a place, based on a shared culture or heritage or other works that explore the notion of identity or belonging for children or teenagers

YXZD.label: Children’s / Teenage social topics: Peace / reconciliation
YXZD.notes: Use for: works for young people about peace after conflict, maintaining peace, ideas for creating, keeping, spreading peace and peaceful actions, resolving conflict, themes and topics around reconciliation between different groups or persons

YXZE.label: Children’s / Teenage social topics: Accidents, disasters or emergencies
YXZE.notes: Use for: either works about the impact or consequences, on both people and society, of both natural and human-made disasters and accidents; things such as diseases, plagues, epidemics, pandemics, famine, malnutrition, volcanic explosions, earthquakes, extreme-weather, floods, forced movement of peoples as a result of disasters; or works about accidents like fires, crashes, shipwrecks, maritime and air disasters or accidents, rail or road accidents, explosions, oil spills, getting trapped or lost, etc; or for titles that explain how to prepare for disasters, emergencies, etc for example, what to do during an earthquake, or major fire or tsunami

YXZF.label: Children’s / Teenage social topics: Fame, celebrity, fandom
YXZF.notes: Use for: works for young people about fame, celebrity, being famous, the search for fame and the issues with being famous or a celebrity, being an idol, being glamorous or wealthy, or works about being a fan or fandom

YXZG.label: Children’s / Teenage social topics: Environment, sustainability and green issues
YXZG.notes: Also class here: looking after our planet, climate change, pollution, rubbish, plastics, recycling, climate emergency, climate strikes, environmental champions, looking after our future, protecting nature, conservation, water use and conservation, managing natural resources, sustainable solutions, reducing consumption and use of resources. Use for: works that look at these topics and also ones that have ideas for solutions, or what young people can do themselves

YXZH.label: Children’s / Teenage: Social topics: Poverty / precarity
YXZH.notes: Use for: works that look at social issues topics in society around social instability, deprivation and hardship, homelessness, the unhoused, hunger, economically disadvantaged, food poverty, etc

YXZM.label: Children’s / Teenage social topics: Migration / refugees
YXZM.notes: Also class here: asylum seekers, immigrants and immigration, emigrants and emigration, displacement, exile, forced journeys or relocation, diasporas. Use with: YNH for history titles or YNB for biographies, YF* for stories and INTEREST 5P* qualifiers as appropriate

YXZR.label: Children’s / Teenage social topics: Religious issues / debates
YXZR.notes: Use for: titles that look at discussions, debates, topics, controversies, or other issues related to religion, belief, faith, religious identity, etc. Use with: YNR* or other Y* codes and 5PG* INTEREST qualifiers as appropriate

YXZW.label: Children’s / Teenage social topics: War and conflict issues

YZ.label: Children’s / Teenage stationery and miscellaneous items
YZ.notes: Use for: Book accessories, gift items and merchandise, non-book products in the book supply chain or identifying a non-book product that has no particular theme or topic and is clearly content free but still needs to be classified as something. Use all YZ* codes for: products such as stationery and non-book articles for children or adolescents that would not be categorised using another Y* subject category as a primary or main subject. Use with: other subject codes as appropriate but YZ* should be the main or principal code. NB: more details of the type non-book product should be sent in other metadata

YZG.label: Children’s / Teenage: Gift and novelty books / items
YZG.notes: Use for: novelty products or books, typically small format and of a decorative, humorous or inspirational nature, often intended to be given as one-off gifts to children or teenagers or for novelty products that do NOT easily fit into other sections and are often displayed at point of sale. DO NOT USE: for marketing purposes indicating a title would make a good gift, (all books make good gifts!)

YZP.label: Children’s / Teenage: Miscellaneous non-book items: Games, puzzles or toys
YZP.notes: Also class here: Board games, travel-games, strategy games, jigsaw puzzles, 3-D puzzles classic games, family games, card games, educational games and toys, book related toys, figurines and action figures, soft toys, etc. Use for: any type of non-book game or puzzle sold separately from books. Use with: other codes to indicate the subject or theme of the game or puzzle. NB: Details of formats and types of games are conveyed in other product metadata

YZS.label: Children’s / Teenage: Stationery items,
YZS.notes: Also class here: any printed stationery item, posters, kits, postcard packs, bookmarks, etc intended for children or teenagers. Use with: another code indicating subject where possible.

YZSD.label: Children’s / Teenage: Printed stationery items: Calendars / diaries
YZSD.notes: Also class here: printed agendas, annual planners, academic year diaries and planners. Use with: other codes to indicate the subject or theme of the calendar or diary. NB: Details of formats and types of calendars or diaries are conveyed in other product metadata

YZSG.label: Children’s / Teenage stationery items: Thematic and guided journals and notebooks
YZSG.notes: Also class here: creative journals, planners, journals or albums to record information about special events. Use for: journals that you fill in, which have some pre-printed text or images to inspire what to write or note down, or entries with a prompt or prompts to write about a particular aspect of your life, but are not linked to a particular year. Use with: another secondary code indicating a subject as appropriate, and 5H* qualifiers if for an event

YZSN.label: Children’s / Teenage: Blank stationery items
YZSN.notes: Also class here: blank exercise books, autograph books, scrapbooks and other content-free items for children or teenagers

YZSP.label: Children’s / Teenage: Stationery items: art and craft supplies
YZSP.notes: Also class here: paints, crayons, crafting kits, stamp kits, painting sets, pens, pencils, brushes
